findings.evidence: Route external web research to Perplexity MCP: perplexity_search for current facts and links
findings.fix: Route external web research to Perplexity MCP: perplexity_search for current facts, links and recent tutorials (default max_results 3, max_tokens_per_page 512), perplexity_ask for sourced synthesis.
